dimension_description: This scale measures how often discrete events happen, canonically in counts per second. It is intentionally broad: biological rhythms, industrial lines, social platforms, digital packets, and physical decays can all be compared once they are expressed as event rates. Each entry states what is being counted so unlike things are not silently conflated.
